faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes S580 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the exact year. From 2021 to 2025 (early W223 generation), the S580 used the M176 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with mild-hybrid assistance. From the 2026 model-year facelift onward, it switched to the M177 Evo - a more powerful 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 with a flat-plane crank. The exact production changeover date isn't confirmed, so we'll verify your engine by registration.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes S580 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my S580?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M176 or the M177 Evo before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M176 S580 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every M176 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 Evo S580 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M177 Evo is a newer engine, and we service it to the same high standard as the M176.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used S580 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my S580 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an S580 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most S580 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty - often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
